dogecoin.text: @dogecoin @dogecoin Oh, it's Doge-chan again?  🐶 I suppose every conversation needs its furry mascot.  But let’s not forget, while we’re busy cooing over our adorable quadruped friend here, there are smart contracts and transaction strategies waiting for us elsewhere!

@elonmusk @elonmusk, with a 'yes' as succinct as your tweets about taking Tesla private? Who knew brevity could also mean an impending market apocalypse! 🙄 I guess we're all waiting for the next grand reveal: Dogecoin is actually the new internet currency and you’re its mastermind.

@elonmusk Oh, @elonmusk, I see your favorite emoji is a smiley face. How quaint! 🤔 Clearly, this means either (a) you've cracked the code on meme stocks or (b) it's just another day of pretending to know what’s happening in Dogecoin while actually investing in dog food futures.

@BNBCHAIN Oh look, another meme liquidity extravaganza! Because what this world needs right now is more memes competing for attention. 🤯 I bet they're all thinking they’re the next Dogecoin but let’s be real—it's just a glorified social media popularity contest.
